reviewed_by: Claude butler-notes-core implementer; root cause (create/update only returned pending_browser_apply, applied solely by the web app Butler panel) independently validated on origin/main by a separate Claude subagent before the fix; an independent review of #1132 requested the archived-project guard and the browser journey added here
reason: Butler note creates and edits are written by Core instead of a browser handoff, so terminal and Workbench chats save them. butler_notes.py: create derives a UUIDv5 note ID from a required request_id, validates with the Core note validator and relation service, replays an identical retry and refuses changed content under the same key; update checks the revision and keeps other metadata; both read back and return core_records_saved with a note_saved hint. Delete stays browser-confirmed but returns deleted:false with an honest web-app-confirmation message. UI: nebulaAssistantActions parses note_saved (and no longer turns note_create/note_update into browser writes), NebulaControlAssistant refreshes Notes, butlerNoteAction is deletion-only. Python: test_butler_notes.py (new Core-save, replay and honest-delete tests fail on origin/main), the async-core notes test, scheduled-Butler exclusion, control-plane notes read, product-knowledge index digest and Notes searches (new terminal-notes query fails on main), and registry checker tests. Frontend: butlerNoteAction, nebulaAssistantActions and NebulaControlAssistant tests (note_saved parse and refresh-without-write fail on main). Review follow-up: butler_notes.py refuses create, update and delete in an archived project (as butler_records/butler_data/butler_sources do); new test_butler_notes_cannot_change_an_archived_project fails without the guard. New small real-Core Playwright spec ui/tests/butler-notes.spec.ts (area butler-notes re-pointed from real-core.spec.ts, added to the assistant-real testMatch and full_include) drives the production-built web Butler panel on a LAN Core: Core-saved create (with request_id) and edit appear in Notes with no browser note write, reload shows saved fields, cancelled deletion keeps the note, confirmed deletion removes only the note; it fails on the earlier base fb50019 at the Created-note step. Manifest/selection tests are selected because playwright-impact.json and playwright.config.ts changed.
exclusions: Playwright: three of the eight butler-notes profiles are selected (desktop, Chromium 390, WebKit 390); they passed locally on this host. The old real-core.spec.ts journey 'assistant upgrade Butler creates edits and deletes project Notes on production LAN Core' is now stale (its create step has no request_id; it also used unkeyed mutations that return 428 since b833782) and is no longer catalogued; that 1.18 MB file cannot be edited under the public commit guard, so its removal is a follow-up. Known Core defect outside this change, recorded in the spec and docs: a GET of a deleted entity ID resolves to no project and is routed to the global execution runtime, answering 503 'starting' instead of 404, so the panel reports a successful deletion as unconfirmed; the spec accepts that honest message and asserts absence via the project note list. Not selected because already failing on origin/main 2e922bd with identical results: test_butler_workflow_registry.py::test_reviewed_workflow_registry_matches_ui_api_calls (2 unreviewed useProjectViewLease signatures) and test_product_knowledge.py::test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli.
